About this Event

BLUE GLOVE PRESENTS: COURTSIDE QAWALI FT. SURSAGAR | ALHAMBRA PALACE RESTAURANT
Featuring the Trending SURSAGAR BAND | Powered by Tamasha Nights
Chicago, get ready for a night where soulful melodies, live energy, and desi nightlife collide. Courtside Qawali brings the trending SURSAGAR BAND to Alhambra Palace Restaurant for an immersive evening built around Sufi soul, Bollywood magic, and the kind of crowd energy that turns a live show into a full-on experience.
From the first note to the last cheer, this is a celebration of music that moves people. Expect powerful vocals, emotional storytelling, and the modern qawali sound that has made Sursagar one of the most talked-about acts right now.

🌟 FEATURING SURSAGAR: THE SOUND OF MODERN QAWALI🔥 The band everyone is talking about, the Voice of Punjab winner!
🎤 Why Sursagar is a must-experience live:

Sufi & Qawali songs with a modern twist: Experience the beauty of live mashups of classic qawalis with the latest Punjabi numbers.

Bollywood melodies that hit differently: Get swept away by beloved favorites and soulful anthems, from Rashq-e-Qamar to Teri Deewani and beyond.

A performance that connects: Feel the emotion, passion, and intensity of music that brings people together beyond language and boundaries.

Viral buzz and social-media appeal: Discover the live musical sensation gaining attention online, with a viral presence and an association with Karan Aujla.

An immersive musical journey: Expect captivating vocals, infectious rhythms, audience sing-alongs, and moments that stay with you long after the final note.

🕯️ THE COURTSIDE QAWALI EXPERIENCEPicture a candlelit setting, a premium nightlife atmosphere, and a room full of people ready to sing, sway, and celebrate together. This is the kind of night that feels intimate, elevated, and unforgettable from start to finish.
